kcal.label: Calories
kcal.note: Set by your profile; everything else is a floor, this is a target.

protein.label: Protein
protein.note: RDA is a minimum to prevent loss, not an optimum.

fat.label: Fat
fat.note: No DRI for total fat in adults; shown for the macro patterns.

carb.label: Carbohydrate
carb.note: No DRI beyond a 130 g/day minimum for brain glucose; shown for keto and low-carb.

fiber.label: Fiber
fiber.note: An Adequate Intake, set from cardiovascular-risk data.

LA.label: Linoleic acid
LA.note: Omega-6. AI is a population median; true deficiency needs far less.

ALA.label: ALA
ALA.note: The only omega-3 with a DRI.

EPADHA.label: EPA + DHA
EPADHA.note: No DRI exists. Shown for information; never counted as a gap.

Ca.label: Calcium
Ca.note: Absorption drops as a single dose rises; split it across the day.

Fe.label: Iron
Fe.note: Plant (non-heme) iron absorbs several times less than heme iron.

P.label: Phosphorus
P.note: Hard to miss on any diet with protein in it.

K.label: Potassium
K.note: An AI, and the one most ordinary diets miss.

Zn.label: Zinc
Zn.note: Phytate in grains and legumes reduces absorption.

Mn.label: Manganese
Mn.note: UL of 11 mg is contested; EFSA declined to set one.

Na.label: Sodium
Na.note: A ceiling, not a target: the AI is 1500 mg and 2300 mg is the level above which intake is advised to come down. Unsalted whole food lands far below both, so what you add is what counts.

Se.label: Selenium
Se.note: Brazil nuts can blow past the UL in a few nuts.

I.label: Iodine
I.note: Seaweed varies enormously; kelp can be dangerous.

A.label: Vitamin A
A.note: The UL applies to preformed A (liver, eggs), not carotene.

C.label: Vitamin C
C.note: Lost to heat and water; cooking cuts it substantially.

D.label: Vitamin D
D.note: Very few foods carry it. Sun and fortification usually do the work.

K1K2.label: Vitamin K
K1K2.note: K1 from greens, K2 from natto, cheese and egg yolk. Both are cofactors for the same enzyme, so they are counted together.

B12.label: Vitamin B12
B12.note: Absent from unfortified plants; fortified plant milks are the practical vegan source.

choline.label: Choline
choline.note: An AI. Eggs and liver dominate; most other foods are minor.

Mo.label: Molybdenum
Mo.note: Legumes and grains carry it; deficiency is basically unknown.
